bootstrap_model.purpose: Materialize or discover the real staging provider state required by AR-8C without weakening the AR-8C read-only acceptance audit.
bootstrap_model.execution_boundary: Explicit protected external/provider ceremony only. It is not a pull-request job, not routine deployment, not opsctl mutation authority and not automatic IaC provisioning.

rules: Inventory the selected staging Cloudflare account and zone before any create operation.
Reuse an existing resource only when its identity and purpose match accepted authority.
Never infer absence from a missing GitHub secret alone.
Never create duplicate resources from guessed names or placeholder identifiers.

accepted_sources: authenticated connected Cloudflare provider session with the accepted bounded bootstrap permissions
temporary environment-scoped Cloudflare bootstrap API token supplied outside Git, issues and chat

external_facts_that_must_not_be_guessed: selected Cloudflare account and owned DNS zone
accepted staging hostname/custom domain when not already fixed by provider state
Google staging OAuth application identity and client secret when the resolver is deployed with Google OAuth enabled
Microsoft staging OAuth application identity and client secret when the resolver is deployed with Microsoft OAuth enabled
bootstrap_model.runtime_secret_destination: Cloudflare Worker secret stores. Runtime secret values are not steady-state GitHub release inputs after AR-8 normalization.

staging_outputs.steady_state_direction: The two bundle bindings are bootstrap/rotation transport only and must be removed from routine application deployment exposure by final AR-8 acceptance; runtime secret presence is then verified by name/metadata through wrangler.secrets.required and provider metadata APIs.
staging_outputs.manifest_source: Real discovered/created staging provider identities only; no placeholder, synthetic or pre-guessed IDs.

preconditions: real staging provider substrate exists and matches accepted authority
required Worker secrets are bound in Cloudflare protected secret stores
steady-state staging Cloudflare API token is active and bound to the staging GitHub Environment
staging Access service-token pair is bound to the staging GitHub Environment
CLOUDFLARE_DEPLOY_MANIFEST_JSON contains the real validated staging identities
bootstrap credential is revoked or otherwise removed from active project deployment authority
ar8c_handoff.failure_policy: Fail closed and report the exact missing external fact, binding or provider metadata. Never fabricate a value, use a placeholder, create a production resource or widen privileges to make the gate green.

remaining_ar8_after_ar8c.objective: Encryption keyring, handle-HMAC and inter-Worker service-auth lifecycle hardening with bounded transition, recovery and negative tests.
Google/Microsoft OAuth application credential validation, rotation/cutover/recovery and provider-constraint hardening without replacing the AR-8A mailbox OAuth state machine.
Metadata-only operator UX, rehearsal, drift/rotation-readiness reporting and the project-wide negative matrix.
Decouple routine immutable application deployment from runtime-secret value transport; retain a separate protected bootstrap/rotation mutation path and name-only required-secret validation.
Freeze one exact candidate SHA, require every applicable permanent check and rehearsal green, merge once with guarded exact-head semantics, close #308 and only then permit AR-9 to start.
